81:t_2:28.en:
$$レイカ$$
「The citizens were scattered over a very wide area in the transfer. Only some people tied to $$トップレス$$ organizations seem to have been jumped here, so we lack the full picture.」

81:t_2:29.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Also, it seems that Earth's humanity in their world had the entire Solar System as its sphere of activity.」

81:t_2:30.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Right now, thanks to the $$時空修復|lc$$ of $$蒼の地球$$, the Solar Systems of the $$蒼の地球$$ world and the $$翠の地球$$ world have merged into one, but...」

81:t_2:31.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Right now, we don't know what has become of the facilities they built on each planet of the Solar System.」

81:t_2:32.en:
$$レイカ$$
「However, they... $$トップレス$$ are continuing to fight the $$宇宙怪獣$$, mysterious creatures in this world as well.」

81:t_2:33.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Or rather, they carry out only that mission, and otherwise make no active effort to make contact with people from other worlds.」

81:t_2:34.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I see... Our $$蒼の地球$$ was also attacked by the $$宇宙怪獣$$, and $$翠の地球$$ was the same, then.」

81:t_2:35.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But the type we fought today wasn't in the data that $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ gave us, either.」

81:t_2:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The name '$$宇宙怪獣$$' is a generic term. We can't conclude that they are the same species.」

81:t_2:37.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The problem is that beings like the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ we know also exist elsewhere.」

81:t_2:38.en:
$$レイカ$$
「From what you say, the $$宇宙怪獣$$ that attack $$翠の地球$$ don't seem to have appeared on $$蒼の地球$$.」

81:t_2:39.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But it's probably only a matter of time.」

81:t_2:40.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Regrettably, I agree. Now that so many $$宇宙怪獣$$ have descended into the atmosphere, their attacks will surely be fiercer than before.」

81:t_2:41.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I want information on the new $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$. Is it possible to contact those $$トップレス$$?」

81:t_2:42.en:
$$レイカ$$
「We have tried to make contact several times so far, but unfortunately...」

81:t_2:43.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Still, looking at it another way, you have to admire them. Fighting of their own accord to protect Earth, with no reward at all.」

81:t_2:44.en:
$$キャシー$$
「With that much firepower... I wish they would cooperate in the fight against the $$サイデリアル$$ too...」

81:t_2:45.en:
$$レイカ$$
「We have been making appeals like that too, but there is still no reply.」

81:t_2:46.en:
$$レイカ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ also seem to be taking a stance of non-interference toward $$トップレス$$, as an organization that only deals with the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

81:t_2:47.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If we can't get their cooperation, we'll just fight with the forces we have.」

81:t_2:48.en:
$$レイカ$$
「The Resistance groups on the $$アメリア$$ Continent are already gathering to take $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

81:t_2:49.en:
$$レイカ$$
「You will be its core, making a breakthrough at a single point to take the enemy base.」

81:t_2:50.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's the operation we're best at.」

81:t_2:51.en:
$$レイカ$$
「I have heard about $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ from $$破嵐$$. With $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ as your foundation, I am sure you will make this operation a success.」

81:t_2:52.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$レイカ$$... Please act as our liaison with each Resistance group for the strategy meeting.」

81:t_2:53.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Understood. Then please move the ship to the point I am about to designate.」

81:t_2:54.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The time has finally come to knock the $$サイデリアル$$ out of this $$翠の地球$$!」

81:t_2:55.en:
$$勝平$$
「The fight on the Central Continent has been brought to a draw. If we smash the bases on the $$アメリア$$ Continent, it'll turn things in Earth's favor all at once.」

81:t_2:56.en:
$$甲児$$
「After we cut off their follow-up forces here, we go back to $$蒼の地球$$...」

81:t_2:57.en:
$$アルト$$
「Once we've liberated $$翠の地球$$, $$蒼の地球$$ is next.」

81:t_2:58.en:
$$勝平$$
「When that time comes, we and Big Bro $$レド$$ will be there with you, too.」

81:t_2:59.en:
$$勝平$$
「We let those $$トップレス$$ guys get away, but with us around, we'll drive the $$サイデリアル$$ out of $$蒼の地球$$ in no time, too!」

81:t_2:60.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's give it our all, everyone!」

81:t_2:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「With a look like that on your face, it isn't convincing at all.」

81:t_2:66.en:
$$マオ$$
「Right now, your feelings show on your face more than you think.」

81:t_2:67.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's right. If you're agonizing over how to settle your two-timing, I'm always here to talk it over.」

81:t_2:68.en:
$n
「Just so I know, what would you do?」

81:t_2:69.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'll take one of them off your hands.」

81:t_2:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「What kind of man are you...」

81:t_2:71.en:
$$マオ$$
「Look. $n... is crying at how pathetic this is.」

81:t_2:74.en:
$n
「Thank you, $$クルツ$$. I'll use it as a reference.」

81:t_2:75.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's a good smile. If I train you right, you could become my successor and inherit everything I have.」

81:t_2:76.en:
$n
「Successor...? I'm not that good at sniping, though...」

81:t_2:77.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Not that kind. I mean the night sniping.」

81:t_2:78.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's enough. Miss $$スズネ$$ is glaring at you from over there.」

81:t_2:79.en:
$$マオ$$
「If this keeps up, she might slide back into that hysterical state she was in before.」

81:t_2:82.en:
$$宗介$$
「Have your worries eased a little?」

81:t_2:83.en:
$n
「...Yeah. It feels silly to be scared of a vague anxiety with no shape.」

81:t_2:84.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's the spirit. Needless fear dulls sound judgment.」

81:t_2:86.en:
$n
(That's right... Rather than fear the anxiety, I should have the will to overcome it...)

81:t_2:87.en:
$n
(The operation to take $$セントラル・ベース$$... I have to make it a success, no matter what...)

81:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...According to the information I have obtained, the $$宇宙怪獣$$ we fought today are called the $$ツインテール級$$.」

81:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Last time we fought a giant shrimp, and today we fought a Twintail...」

81:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My gourmet sensor reacted to something, but I can't produce a proper answer.」

81:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... dim-witted as I am, this is my limit.」

81:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get to it today... Business, business!」

82:t_000:0.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「You summoned your unit by spatial transfer!? What's the principle behind that!?」

82:t_000:1.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「H-he's...! Is that the $$トップレス$$ we've heard rumors about!?」

82:t_000:2.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「But... we were told we had a non-aggression pact with them...!」

82:t_000:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't care what the regular army guys decided. We're 《$$フラタニティ$$》.」

82:t_000:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Besides, you're the ones who broke the treaty.」

82:t_000:5.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「When did we ever lay a hand on you!?」

82:t_000:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It's an eyesore, you making a mess right in front of me.」

82:t_001:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So you've brought out your machines... If you had meekly backed off, I would have let you go.」

82:t_001:1.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「$$トップレス$$ or whatever you are, you're just an Earthling in the end!」

82:t_001:2.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Show the people in town what happens to those who defy the $$サイデリアル$$!」

82:t_001:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're small fry through and through, you lot...」

82:t_002:1.en:
$$店長$$
「Could it be... that was... 《$$トップレス$$》...」
